subject: Request: short sandbox/top-up while we fix SDK rollback
messages:
From: Elena Vargas <elena@stratech.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stratech.io, devops@stratech.io
Date: 2028-03-27T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline — unexpected rollback in staging, need short runway

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from the engineering side at Stratech — we hit an SDK regression in our staging run this morning that caused a rollback of the connector. Our engineers are on it but the fix involves a deeper change to our adapter that will take ~10 working days to validate across QA and security.

We're mid-POC and the team is out of sandbox credits; without an immediate top-up the demo environment will be unusable for customer-facing tests. Can Redwood provision a small sandbox/top-up (we estimate ~200k tokens worth) and extend our trial window by two weeks so we can finish the fix and run the acceptance tests? Attached are the compressed staging logs and a short runbook (staging_logs.zip) that show the rollback pattern.

We really want to keep momentum with the pilot — customer demo is scheduled for 4/12 and we need the environment stable before then. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena Vargas
VP Product, Stratech Solutions
elena@stratech.io
+1 415-555-0182

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>

Folks — forwarding Elena's note. Stratech is a mid-size fintech POC (DEAL-4982) and they just hit a staging regression that will push their acceptance tests out ~10 business days. They asked for a 2-week trial extension + a sandbox top-up (they estimate ~200k tokens).

Can we provision an interim top-up and extend the trial while we confirm the fix? Proposed route:
- Approve provisional 200k token sandbox credit (equivalent ~$1.2k) so their engineers can continue testing immediately.
- Require execution of a short mutual action plan (attached MA-proposal-draft.pdf) and HubSpot acknowledgement to track the extension.
- Engineering (David) — can you review the logs Elena attached and confirm there are no platform compatibility issues on our side that would make this request risky?

Ben — can you approve the credit and lead the outreach? Lauren — please flag anything special for support/CS once we enable. I'm on standby to sign the MAP.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.ai
